title: Among patients who have at least two laboratory tests with elevated total b
question: Among patients who have at least two laboratory tests with elevated total bilirubin (T-BIL ≥ 2.0), how many also have at least one test showing abnormal IgM (≤40 or ≥400) and are male?

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.XCL_058)
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.XCL_059 = 'M'
  AND P.XCL_058 IN (
    SELECT L2.XCL_014
    FROM Laboratory AS L2
    WHERE L2.XCL_037 >= 2.0
    GROUP BY L2.XCL_014
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
  )
  AND P.XCL_058 IN (
    SELECT L3.XCL_014
    FROM Laboratory AS L3
    WHERE L3.XCL_044 <= 40 OR L3.XCL_044 >= 400
  )

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.XCL_058)
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
WHERE P.XCL_059 = 'M'
  AND P.XCL_058 IN (
    SELECT L2.XCL_014
    FROM Laboratory L2
    WHERE L2.XCL_022 >= 2.0
    GROUP BY L2.XCL_014
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
  )
  AND P.XCL_058 IN (
    SELECT L3.XCL_014
    FROM Laboratory L3
    WHERE L3.XCL_018 <= 40 OR L3.XCL_018 >= 400
  )
